main.formula: no WebGPU on this page (0016 §1's 110 B floor does not apply): measured harness overhead, ceil(max of 50 clean runs = 45.43-45.55 B/frame) = 46, + 8 B margin (0016 §1's own margin convention) = 54

sim.formula: 0016 §1: the strict worker figure. Measured clean here: constant 2.97 B/frame (1784 B / 600) over 50 runs, comfortably under the 8 B figure the spike's minimal worker measured at 0.99 B/frame

main.formula: 0016 §1 margin convention, measured against the worse of two scenarios (docs/plan/06b-workers-and-spawn.md, Deviations "fix round 2"): after fixing the two real per-frame allocation bugs (parkWorkers/resumeWorkers's per-tick `.every()` closure, and ManualClock.fireDue's per-`advance()` empty-Map iterator -- both scaled with contention, not frames, so no warm-up count fixed them), clean max of 8 runs = 38.71 B/frame, but a sibling isolate's own `burst` control measurably raises `main`'s own reading too (44 seen with `gen0` bursting) -- ceil(44) = 44, + 8 B margin = 52. `object` control on `main` itself measured 63.8, comfortably above.

client.formula: 0016 §1 margin convention, measured against the worse of two scenarios (docs/plan/06b-workers-and-spawn.md, Deviations "fix round 2", residual cross-isolate finding): clean max of 8 runs = 13.22 B/frame, but a *sibling* isolate's own `burst` control (`sim`/`gen0`) measurably raises `client`'s own reading to 21.4-25.0 even with no other contention -- ceil(25.0) = 25, + 8 B margin = 33. `object` control on `client` itself measured 36.64, still comfortably above.

sim.formula: 0016 §1: the strict worker figure (same as gc-loop's own sim entry). Measured max of 8 clean runs = 7.33 B/frame, comfortably under 8; `object` control on `sim` itself measured 19.79.

gen0.formula: 0016 §1: the strict worker figure. Identical measured shape to `sim`: max of 8 clean runs = 7.33 B/frame; `object` control on `gen0` itself measured 19.79.

main.formula: 0016 §1 margin convention (post fix-round-2, see `topology`'s own `main` formula for the residual cross-isolate finding this also budgets for): measured max of 8 clean runs = 27.49 B/frame, ceil = 28, + 8 B margin, rounded up to 40 for the same sibling-burst headroom `topology` needed. `object` control on `main` itself measured 52.31, comfortably above.

client.formula: 0016 §1 margin convention, measured against the worse of two scenarios (see `topology`'s own `client` formula for the residual cross-isolate finding): clean max of 8 runs = 8.59 B/frame (varies 0.8-8.6: whether the echo round trip's response arrives before or after the frame's own ring-drain check), but a sibling isolate's own `burst` control raises this by a similar margin to `topology`'s own `client` (+~12) -- ceil(21) = 21, + 8 B margin = 29. `object` control on `client` itself measured 24.2-31.9; kept above 29 by re-checking after this change (Deviations).

gen0.formula: 0016 §1: the strict worker figure. Identical measured shape to `sim`: max of 8 clean runs = 7.33 B/frame; `object` control on `gen0` itself measured 19.29.

sab.formula: docs/decisions/0015-threads-memory-and-topology.md §5's ~12 MiB SAB budget line, in bytes (12 * 1024 * 1024). Measured sab/layout.ts sabBytesTotal() (two gen workers, the worst case): 8,277,684 B (~7.9 MiB) -- control 256 B + camera 80 B + clock seqlock 36 B + drawList triple 3*(1,024 + 2,097,152) B + six single rings + two gen-worker ring pairs (docs/plan/06-sab-primitives-and-workers.md, Ring capacities).
